settings.question: Will anyone know what I ordered?
settings.answer: No. Every order ships in a plain brown parcel with no product name outside. The courier sees only a parcel. Your invoice says only the company's legal name.

settings.question: Is this real Ayurveda or bus-stand medicine?
settings.answer: Every formulation is AYUSH-licensed and every batch is lab-tested, with reports you can download from the product page. We name every ingredient and cite the classical source. We never promise miracles — and we put that in writing.

settings.question: Can I pay on delivery?
settings.answer: Yes. Cash on Delivery is available across India, along with UPI, cards and netbanking at checkout.

settings.question: How does the consultation work?
settings.answer: Buy a consultation like any product. After checkout you receive a booking link on WhatsApp and email — choose phone or video, and a time that suits you. It is 100% private and with a registered practitioner.

settings.question: Can my wife/husband join the consultation?
settings.answer: Yes — and we encourage it. Our doctors and counsellors regularly see couples. Intimacy is a shared health matter, and there is no judgment here.

settings.shloka: सर्वे भवन्तु सुखिनः सर्वे सन्तु निरामयाः
settings.translation: May all be happy; may all be free of disease.
